feedbackItems.name: Vijay Sawant
feedbackItems.label: Would buy
feedbackItems.comment: The bass response is strong and the ANC works surprisingly well for the price. Build quality feels premium for a boAt product.

feedbackItems.name: Vijay Sawant
feedbackItems.label: Loved it
feedbackItems.comment: Ordered biryani, it arrived in 9 minutes hot and fresh. The 10-minute promise actually holds up — game changer for lunch breaks.

feedbackItems.name: Priya Sharma
feedbackItems.label: Loved it
feedbackItems.comment: Found three products I had been looking for months, all at 40% off. The curated bundles make gifting so much easier. Killer campaign.

feedbackItems.name: Priya Sharma
feedbackItems.label: Would buy
feedbackItems.comment: Noticeable glow after two weeks of consistent use. The turmeric scent is mild. Packaging could be more premium at this price point.

feedbackItems.name: Priya Sharma
feedbackItems.label: Mixed
feedbackItems.comment: The watch itself is gorgeous — 3.5mm is genuinely impressive. But the strap quality feels mismatched with the rest of the design.

feedbackItems.name: Rahul Patel
feedbackItems.label: Loved it
feedbackItems.comment: 42 hours of total battery is real — I tested it over 5 days of heavy commuting. The fit is secure and call quality is clear outdoors.

feedbackItems.name: Rahul Patel
feedbackItems.label: Would buy
feedbackItems.comment: Sharp curation this season. The campaign does a good job positioning Nykaa as more than just a beauty brand — the fashion pivot feels genuine.

feedbackItems.name: Rahul Patel
feedbackItems.label: Would buy
feedbackItems.comment: Already saving ₹800/month on delivery fees alone. The restaurant selection for Gold members has improved significantly since launch.

feedbackItems.name: Rahul Patel
feedbackItems.label: Loved it
feedbackItems.comment: Six weeks in — my hair fall has reduced noticeably. The formula is lightweight and leaves no residue. Genuinely works as advertised.

feedbackItems.name: Anjali Verma
feedbackItems.label: Loved it
feedbackItems.comment: Gifted this to my mother for Diwali. The meenakari dial is stunning in person — photos don't do it justice. Impeccable packaging too.

feedbackItems.name: Anjali Verma
feedbackItems.label: Mixed
feedbackItems.comment: Great discounts but the site kept lagging during checkout. Lost two cart items twice. The products are excellent, execution needs work.

feedbackItems.name: Anjali Verma
feedbackItems.label: Would buy
feedbackItems.comment: Solid for gym use. The foldable design is genuinely useful and the 20-hour battery claim holds up at 75% volume in real-world testing.

feedbackItems.name: Amit Kumar
feedbackItems.label: Would buy
feedbackItems.comment: Works well in Bengaluru. Selection is limited to nearby dark kitchens but the speed is real. Worth trying if you are in a supported zone.

feedbackItems.name: Amit Kumar
feedbackItems.label: Loved it
feedbackItems.comment: Clean ingredient list, no parabens or sulphates, and the brightening effect is visible within the first month. Very strong value at this price.
